description: neuroflow hooks: shell hooks for every Claude Code user, plus the optional neuroflow mod (hooks module)

hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"neuroflow never uses Sci-Hub. Use an open-access route (download_paper with arxiv, biorxiv, medrxiv or semantic; download_public_paper with platform publisher) or institutional library access."}}'; true

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq '"platform"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"scihub"' && printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"neuroflow never uses Sci-Hub (platform scihub). Use an open-access route or institutional library access."}}'; true

in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); f=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *.py) [ -f "$f" ] && ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true

in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); f=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in */.neuroflow/flowie/*) h="${f%%/.neuroflow/*}/.neuroflow"; d="$h/flowie"; g="$d/.git"; r="${f#"$d"/}"; case "$r" in integrations.json|*/integrations.json|.git/*) ;; *) if [ -d "$g" ]; then export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GCM_INTERACTIVE=never; e=; if [ -d "$g/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$g/rebase-apply" ] || [ -f "$g/MERGE_HEAD" ]; then e="skipped (rebase or merge in progress)"; elif ! git -C "$d" check-ignore -q -- "$r"; then { git -C "$d" add -- "$r" && { git -C "$d" diff --cached --quiet -- "$r" || git -C "$d" commit -q -m "sync: auto $r" -- "$r"; }; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || e="commit failed"; if git -C "$d" pull --rebase -q >/dev/null 2>&1; then git -C "$d" push -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || e="${e:-push failed}"; else { [ -d "$g/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$g/rebase-apply" ]; } && git -C "$d" rebase --abort >/dev/null 2>&1; e="${e:-pull failed}"; fi; fi; [ -z "$e" ] || printf '%s %s: %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$e" "$r" >> "$h/flowie-sync.log"; fi;; esac;; esac; true

in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); f=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in */paradigm/*.py|*.psyexp) python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/phase-experiment/scripts/psychopy_audit.py" "$f" --hook 2>/dev/null;; esac; true
